acceptanceCriteria: With the containerised RSpec provider declared, a services-dependent suite reaches PASS/FAIL baseline and mutant verdicts instead of UNSUPPORTED.
Each mutant applies in a disposable copy and carries its own admitted container receipt.
Spec requirements trace to tests; host-sandbox path unchanged when no profile is declared.
body: GitHub #1354: mutated RSpec runs only under host sandbox-exec/bwrap with network denied, so suites needing DB/cache services or container-only gems never pass baseline and every row is NOT_RUN/UNSUPPORTED. #1333/PR 1341 added admitted receipts for containerised RSpec runs. Request: mutation rows execute via that container runner path (or any declared runner profile), keeping: exported revision never written, each mutant in a disposable copy, per-run receipt.
title: prove --mutate: run RSpec mutants through the declared containerised runner profile, not only the host sandbox (GH #1354 part 2)
